sql: WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT au.id, au.email FROM auth.users au JOIN public.user_companies uc ON uc.user_id = au.id WHERE uc.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') SELECT u.email, (SELECT count(*) FROM auth.sessions s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AS sessoes_ativas, (SELECT string_agg(to_char(s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') || ' ult.uso ' || coalesce(to_char(s.refreshed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI'), '-') || ' ' || left(coalesce(s.user_agent, ''), 30), ' | ' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC) FROM auth.sessions s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AS sessoes, (SELECT count(*) FROM auth.refresh_tokens r WHERE r.user_id = u.id::text AND r.created_at > now() - interval '8 days') AS tokens_8d, (SELECT to_char(max(au.updated_at) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') FROM auth.users au WHERE au.id = u.id) AS usuario_alterado, (SELECT to_char(au.last_sign_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') FROM auth.users au WHERE au.id = u.id) AS ultimo_login, (SELECT count(*) FROM auth.audit_log_entries a WHERE a.created_at > now() - interval '8 days') AS audit_total FROM u
